prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it, check properties, put down if heavy. If not, approach or move randomly. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties>     <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    />     <Action ID = PutObjectDown    /> </SubTree> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomLocation    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO PutObjectDown
	END
